hooks.command: [ "$(git branch --show-current)" != "main" ] || { echo '{"block": true, "message": "Direct edits on main are blocked. Create a feature branch first: git checkout -b feat/your-feature"}' >&2; exit 2; }

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'); try{console.log(JSON.parse(d).path||'')}catch(e){}"); [ -z "$file" ] && exit 0; case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck 2>&1 | head -20 ;; esac

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'); try{console.log(JSON.parse(d).path||'')}catch(e){}"); [ -z "$file" ] && exit 0; case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx eslint --fix "$file" --quiet 2>/dev/null ;; esac

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'); try{console.log(JSON.parse(d).path||'')}catch(e){}"); [ -z "$file" ] && exit 0; case "$file" in prisma/schema.prisma) echo '{"feedback": "schema.prisma modified — remember to run: npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push"}' >&2 ;; esac
